project.title: NOT 4 SALE
project.description: A short comic about a starving female artist who finds a beautiful painting of a woman at the museum except, it's weird the artwork's creator shares the same name as her.

project.title: Imaginary Friends
project.description: A short comic about ghosts befriending lonely children to accompany them until they are at an age where their imagination weakens due to reality.

project.title: One Last Time
project.description: A comic about six graduating high school students decide to explore an abandoned amusement park as their last adventure only for the amusement park to trap them inside.
